overview: Grimling Warfront is the active battlefield where Grimling warbands clash with Seru expeditionary forces. Acrylia corruption fuels Grimling aggression and destabilizes the frontline.
history: Grimling tribes formed warfront trenches after unifying under war-chiefs.
Seru expeditionary forces established patrol lines to contain Grimling expansion.
Acrylia shards were discovered near the warfront, mutating Grimling siege beasts.
Forest corruption seeped into the trenches, creating hazardous terrain.
Skirmishes escalated into a permanent warfront stalemate.
hooks: A Grimling warband prepares a massive offensive.
Seru forces attempt to reclaim a lost trench.
A corrupted siege beast emerges from the forest.
Acrylia shards destabilize the warfront terrain.
